info.name: Orderflow scenarios
info.description:
Scenario flows for the Orderflow API. Each folder is one flow that runs top to bottom, checks every response and passes ids to the next request through collection variables.

Setup: run `make postman-env` to write postman/local.postman_environment.json from your .env, import that environment and this collection, start the server, then run a folder or the whole collection with the Collection Runner. From a terminal: `make flows`.

Private requests are signed by the collection pre-request script. Each flow uses its own market and cancels what it leaves behind, so flows can run again on the same server.

item.description: Stop orders wait outside the book until a trade reaches their stop price. The flow sets the last price with a trade, places a buy stop-limit and a sell stop-market, moves the price through both, and cleans up. Runs on LINK-USD.
